parent_objective: audit M2413 source-linked measured-validation result before deciding localization, consolidation, synthesis, stop, or pivot
blocked_by: family membership is overlapping and cannot be ranked
M2413 does not execute the fair finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID intervention protocols
supersedes: direct repair execution from raw M2413 outcomes
family ranking from overlapping membership rows
current-sim verdict from a single measured artifact

public_gates: M2414 must audit M2413 result_class and completeness counters
M2414 must classify the offtrack-dominated measured outcome
M2414 must preserve family-membership diagnostics as non-ranking metadata
M2414 must decide between localization, consolidation, synthesis, stop, or pivot
M2414 must not rerun measured validation, execute repair, train, replay, PPO, rank, select winner, or make verdict claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not rerun M2413 measured validation
do not inject hidden or oracle actor features
do not rank selected checkpoints or profiles
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim scenario redesign executed
do not claim training repair success

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits the bounded measured-validation artifact and chooses the next evidence route
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit only; no rerun, repair execution, training, ranking, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, self-ID, scenario-redesign-executed, training-repair, or current-sim verdict claim
stop_condition: stop if M2413 is incomplete or has contract/metric/metadata failures
stop if family membership is used as ranking
stop if the audit routes directly to repair execution without localization or synthesis
stop if the audit claims current-sim or paper verdict from M2413 alone
fallback_plan: route to artifact-only outcome localization if M2413 is complete but offtrack-dominated
route to branch synthesis if additional localization would repeat existing M2399/M2401 evidence without new decision value
stop or pivot if M2413 exposes invalid metadata, metric artifacts, or contract violations
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: synthesize after at most 10 milestones in this branch or if another non-evidence chain appears

allowed_updates: M2414 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the audit
next_stage_criteria: audit accepts or rejects M2413 completeness
dominant measured failure mode is classified
family-membership and profile slices are treated as diagnostic-only
a bounded next route is selected or the branch is stopped

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2414 audits measured outcomes but does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2414; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU verdict is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Offtrack-dominated outcome should be classified as engineering/task-quality blocker, not as self-ID evidence.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, effective-candidate ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, scenario-redesign-executed result, training-repair result, current-sim verdict, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: audits a new 5250-episode measured panel rather than another design-only branch
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can classify engineering/task-quality blocker and admit localization or synthesis but cannot establish paper/current-sim verdict
must_synthesize_if: another result audit is proposed after M2414 without outcome localization, synthesis, stop, or pivot
family or profile slices are used as ranking
five milestones pass without measured evidence or synthesis

hypothesis: Auditing M2413 will determine whether the complete source-linked measured-validation artifact should route to outcome localization, consolidation, synthesis, stop, or pivot without ranking or verdict claims.
success_criteria: the audit accepts or rejects M2413 completeness explicitly
the dominant outcome blocker is classified
a bounded next route is selected or the branch is stopped
no measured rerun repair training ranking or verdict claim is made
failure_criteria: M2414 ranks candidate families, profiles, or selected checkpoints
M2414 makes measured driver success, current-sim, paper, FW-vs-GRU, or self-ID claims
decision_rule: M2414 passes if it audits M2413 completeness and measured outcome, classifies the dominant blocker, and selects a bounded non-ranking next route or stops without rerun, repair, training, ranking, or verdict claims.
